acceptanceCriteria: Given an obligation or cited source lines, each cited branch lists reaching tests grouped by boundary (unit, request, e2e) with an explicit 'none at <boundary>' entry.

For uncovered branches, the guard condition is returned with the setup endpoints, factories or fixtures whose writes can satisfy it (dependency graph between setup handlers and the models the condition reads); a branch guarded by a model attribute a setup endpoint writes lists that endpoint.

Unresolvable guard inputs are reported as unresolved, never as 'no setup available'; requirements in the owning impact/recommend spec; focused tests via heavy.sh; dogfood CEM; build-log entry; Closes #1175.
body: GitHub #1175. For an obligation citing source branches (validation, conflict check, fallback), authors must find alone which existing tests reach each branch at the needed boundary (unit/request/e2e) and which setup endpoints/factories/fixtures can produce the branch precondition; several sessions stalled on this. Requested: impact/recommend take an obligation or cited lines and return per branch the reaching tests grouped by boundary (explicit none-at-boundary), the guard condition for uncovered branches, and setup endpoints/factories whose effects satisfy it, fail-closed when guard inputs are unresolved.
title: GH #1175: impact/recommend: per cited branch, existing tests by boundary and setup endpoints that can produce its precondition
